# Enigma2

Every app in this list that runs on Enigma2. That is 3 apps with 1 for Plex and 1 for Jellyfin and 2 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Video and general

- [Dreamfin](https://github.com/jrodzar/DreamFin) - Enigma2 (OpenATV) plugin for browsing and playing libraries. `Jellyfin` `Emby` · `Enigma2` · `GPL-2.0` `Free`
- [DreamPlex](https://github.com/oe-alliance/DreamPlex) - Plex client plugin for Enigma2 Linux set-top boxes. `Plex` · `Enigma2` · `Open source` `Free` · [Source (original)](https://github.com/DonDavici/DreamPlex)
- [E2EmbyClient](https://github.com/DimitarCC/e2-emby-client) - Enigma2 set-top box plugin that browses Emby libraries and plays films, series and live TV with the box's own player. `Emby` · `Enigma2` · `GPL-3.0` `Free` · [Info](https://emby.media/community/topic/140442-emby-client-for-linux-enigma2-based-stbs/)
